title: Platinum Blonde
rules: Place digits 1-9 once each in every row, column and 3x3 box.

source.creator: coloin (attributed in the benchmark posting)
source.note: 21-given grid in David Bernier's 10 May 2013 posting, labeled HardestSudokusThread-00078;Platinum_Blonde. Also studied by Ercsey-Ravasz and Toroczkai, The Chaos Within Sudoku (2012), Figure 2b.
